items.name: ftscroller
items.description: FTScroller is a cross-browser Javascript/CSS library to allow touch, mouse or scrollwheel scrolling within specified elements, with pagination, snapping and bouncing support.

items.name: pwacompat
items.description: PWACompat to bring Web App Manifest to older browsers

items.name: WKZombie
items.description: WKZombie is a Swift framework for iOS/OSX to navigate within websites and collect data without the need of User Interface or API, also known as Headless browser. It can be used to run automated tests / snapshots and manipulate websites using Javascript.

items.name: agentql
items.description: AgentQL is a suite of tools for connecting your AI to the web. Featuring a query language and Playwright integrations for interacting with elements and extracting data quickly, precisely, and at scale. Includes REST API, Python and JavaScript SDKs, browser debugger.

items.name: supabase-swift
items.description: A Swift SDK for Supabase. Query your Supabase database, subscribe to realtime events, upload and download files, browse Swift examples, invoke postgres functions via rpc, invoke supabase edge functions, query pgvector.

items.name: detect-gpu
items.description: Classifies GPUs based on their 3D rendering benchmark score allowing the developer to provide sensible default settings for graphically intensive applications.
